entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help. I'm calling about returning a VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so worried I've missed the window and I feel awful about it.
I can certainly look into that return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF8675309.

Got it, thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 17 days ago. To best help, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It was a gift that just didn't work out. But the real problem is, I tried to return it on day nine, and your website just... wouldn't let me. I was really counting on that refund, you know? I've been a VeloFit customer for years and this is the first time I've had an issue.

I understand your concern. The VeloBand Pulse does have a strict 10-day return policy, so trying on day nine was the correct procedure. Can you tell me more about what happened when you tried to process the return online?
The page kept giving me a `website error`. I must have tried five times. I even took a `screenshot` because I was so frustrated. I `couldn't print` the shipping label or even get to that step.
I see. Let me cross-reference that with our system status logs. You said you tried on the ninth day after delivery? That would have been around December 24th. Please hold for one moment.
Okay, thank you... I just really hope this can be sorted out.

Thank you for waiting... And thank you for bringing this to my attention. I can confirm on our end that our return portal had a known `system down` event for several hours on that date. I am so sorry that you were affected by our technical issue.
Really? So it wasn't just my computer?

No, it was definitely an issue on our side. Since you made the return attempt within the valid policy window and were prevented by a VeloFit business fault, I am absolutely authorized to make an exception. I can approve this return for a full refund.
Oh, Charlie, that's incredible news! You have no idea what a relief that is. Thank you, thank you!

You're very welcome. It was our error, and I'm happy to make it right. I've just emailed a prepaid return label to you. Please pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be issued as soon as it's processed in our warehouse.
That's perfect. I'll get that sent out this afternoon. You've been a huge help.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with for VeloFit today?
Nope, that's everything! Have a wonderful New Year!
You as well. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
